name: Harley-Davidson Model A / B Peashooter
engine: 350 cc air-cooled single, side valve or OHV
intro: Harley's single-cylinder 21 cubic inch bikes, nicknamed Peashooters for the OHV version's exhaust note.

H: Check whether yours has a total-loss or a recirculating oil system before you fill it, and know which one you are running.

recallNote: Any recalls on bikes this old were closed long ago.
